note: Montana FWP fishing access site (8 acres, ~4,830 ft) on Ennis Lake with camping. Directions (FWP): 6 miles north of Ennis on Hwy 287 to milepost 55 at McAllister, turn right onto North Ennis Lake Road, then east 2 miles. FWP: 'Very shallow shoreline; boat ramp available at BLM site Kobayashi Beach.' --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page: confirms the fee picture already recorded (no FAS camping fee listed, only the conservation licenses MT resident $8 / nonresident $10 - the manual AWH-priced $20 for two left as is), campsite and toilet. Added the published 25-ft trailer limit (the note said none was published) and the 7-day stay limit. Year-round season (manual) unchanged.
